title: 420Explorer scope-conflict resolution register

conflicts.subject: governance view

source_a.value: Blocks, transactions, contracts, validators, assets, finality
source_a.interpretation: The frozen Explorer application-purpose wording has been reconciled and no longer names governance.

source_b.interpretation: Dedicated Explorer Genesis profile omits a governance requiredView.

implementation_observation.statement: No dedicated Explorer governance API/view was established in the qualified required-view path set.

decision_authority.rationale: The conflict is between two authoritative scope descriptions; source inspection cannot legitimately choose one by inference.

admissible_resolutions.label: Governance view is mandatory for Explorer Genesis
required_actions: Reclassify EXP-CAP-019 as mandatory_genesis and define concrete Explorer/Indexer implementation path.
Add governance workflow/API/UI/data-source requirements and acceptance tests.
Update EXP-FIND-001 from unresolved scope conflict to the resulting implementation/runtime findings until satisfied.
Update EXP-REQ-SCOPE-001 into a mandatory required-view requirement or replace it with an equivalent stable mandatory requirement.
Update EXP-0.3.4 frozen status and remove governance from scope_decision_required.
Update AC-5 and AC-10 evidence requirements for the new mandatory view.
Qualify all new source/runtime/deployment work before final EXP-0 closeout.
admissible_resolutions.prohibited_shortcut: Do not mark governance mandatory without adding a real implementation/test/qualification path.

admissible_resolutions.label: Governance wording is descriptive ecosystem scope, not a mandatory Explorer Genesis view
required_actions: Amend config/genesis-applications.json purpose wording or add an explicit scope note so it no longer implies a required dedicated governance view.
Retire EXP-CAP-019 scope_decision_required classification without adding governance to requiredViews.
Close EXP-FIND-001 with the recorded authoritative decision.
Retire or supersede EXP-REQ-SCOPE-001 and update EXP-0.3.4 frozen status.
Remove EXP-FIND-001 from AC-5 and AC-10 blocking_findings only after the authoritative sources agree.
Re-run all retained EXP-0 qualification gates.
admissible_resolutions.prohibited_shortcut: Do not simply delete the blocker while config/genesis-applications.json still names governance ambiguously.

conflicts.current_closeout_rule: The governance scope conflict is resolved by EXP-0.3.8. Final EXP-0 closeout remains subject to all other Genesis-blocking findings and acceptance criteria.
conflicts.resolution_statement: Governance is descriptive ecosystem subject matter and is not a mandatory dedicated 420Explorer Genesis view.
resolved_effects: config/genesis-applications.json no longer names governance in the Explorer purpose.
contracts/config/420explorer-genesis.json remains authoritative for the mandatory requiredViews set and continues to omit governance.
EXP-CAP-019 and EXP-REQ-SCOPE-001 are retired from active scope.
EXP-FIND-001 is retained as resolved historical evidence and is non-blocking.
AC-5 and AC-10 no longer list EXP-FIND-001 as a blocker.

rules: Every authoritative scope conflict must appear exactly once in this register.
A conflict may be marked resolved only by an explicit authoritative decision record and complete atomic reconciliation.
Resolution must reconcile every file in the conflict's atomic_reconciliation_manifest.
No scope_decision_required item may be silently reclassified as optional, post-Genesis, or mandatory.
A resolved conflict must no longer have contradictory authoritative source values.
Only unresolved conflicts with genesis_blocking=true block final EXP-0/Genesis scope closeout.
EXP-0.3.6 qualification means the conflict-management mechanism is complete and fail-closed; it does not mean the product-scope conflict itself has been decided.
